svg.title: What each validation option uses
svg.desc: A comparison of validation options and the data each uses. A tailored demo uses a prepared scenario or uploaded customer files, with no connectors. A sandbox uses uploaded files for an allotted group of users, with no connectors. A pilot connects to the customer's systems for a defined cohort.
